items: Offer a drink at least every 2 hours. Aim for about 1.5 litres of fluid a day.
Record how much of each meal is eaten. Tell the nurse if two meals in a row are mostly left.
Help to reposition at least every 3 hours when in bed or in a chair for a long time.
Enjoys a daily phone call with her daughter. Note when she calls.
Uses a walking frame. Staff stay close when she stands up.
Falls risk. Staff stay within arm's reach when Ron stands from a chair or goes to the bathroom.
The walking frame must be within reach at all times.
Encourage a drink with each meal and at morning and afternoon tea.
Likes to eat breakfast at the dining table.
Tell the nurse after any slip, trip or near-fall.
Offer small, light meals. Tell the nurse if she says she feels sick.
Record any vomiting: the time, and roughly how much.
Encourage sips of fluid often through the day.
Enjoys the afternoon music group.
Sleeps best with the door open and the hallway light on.
Prefers halal meals. Check the meal label at each meal.
Daily walk in the garden if the weather is fine.
Enjoys bingo and group games in the afternoon.
Encourage a drink with each meal.
Prays in his room at midday. Keep the room quiet at that time.

home_procedures: Any fall or near-fall must be reported to the nurse on shift straight away and written in the note.
If a resident vomits, write down the time and tell the nurse on shift.
If a resident refuses a meal, write it in the note and offer an alternative.
If a resident says they are in pain, tell the nurse on shift and write down what they said.
Record at least one drink offered at each round on the fluid chart.
Write notes in plain words about what you saw and heard. Do not guess the cause.
